premises.text: Personalization can significantly improve user engagement and conversion rates
premises.evidence_span: we had a 241% improvement in click-through rate, a 150% improvement in engagement. In this case, those were bids for them. And a 102% improvement in actual on-revenue new conversion

premises.text: Current personalization methods are ineffective because they rely on historical data
premises.evidence_span: personalization has really meant looking at historical data, likes that people have, different other things around like cohorts and segments and A-B testing. The problem is none of that really targets you at this very moment in time

premises.text: Lift Igniter's platform personalizes content in real-time for every user
premises.evidence_span: we built a platform for every single vertical across all types of content, across every single touchpoint, and across all devices

premises.text: The integration of Lift Igniter's platform is quick and easy for customers
premises.evidence_span: it took minutes to integrate, not months

premises.text: Lift Igniter processes user actions in real-time to provide immediate personalized responses
premises.evidence_span: every time that a user takes an action, it's processed by our algorithms, it's returned to the site, all in 125 millisecond round trip

premises.text: Lift Igniter can handle a large volume of data and user interactions
premises.evidence_span: we scan over 300 million items a day. We have 350 billion signals that we're gathering a month

premises.text: The company has a sustainable business model with profitable growth
premises.evidence_span: we're profitable today, and we have over six figures in revenue, monthly recurring revenue, and we have spent almost no money on sales and marketing

value.text: Users receive personalized content that enhances their engagement and conversion
